question: How many Khelo India centres did the Delhi government propose to establish in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The initiative aligns with the national **Khelo India Programme**, which aims to identify and nurture sports talent across India.
 
• The **Khelo India centres** are intended to focus on grassroots-level sports and provide training under qualified coaches to enhance the skills and performance of budding athletes.
 
• The proposal includes setting up centres for various sports disciplines to ensure inclusivity and to cater to the interests of athletes across different sports.
